purpose: Test the LumenCore routing and orchestration hypothesis by prospectively choosing an authority-specific specialist before actual demand is available.
core_hypothesis: A frozen hybrid specialist router has lower prospective seasonal-MASE than the best fixed specialist evaluated over the same future common-intersection targets.
design_boundary: The route map was designed after inspecting data through 2026-07-12. Historical improvements are exploratory only. No target dated after the cutoff may influence the route map, specialist settings, features, or gates.

historical_design_evidence.claim_rule: These historical routed figures explain the frozen design but are not confirmation evidence because they informed the route map.

source.product: Form EIA-930 daily demand and day-ahead demand forecast by balancing authority
source.credential_policy: Read EIA_API_KEY or EIA_API_KEY_PREMIUM from the process environment and never serialize the credential.

specialists.definition: The fixed residual XGBoost feature and hyperparameter contract from EIA_GRID_RESIDUAL_MOE_20260713, fitted on eligible observations available before the target.
The fixed direct LightGBM feature and hyperparameter contract from EIA_GRID_RESIDUAL_MOE_20260713, fitted on eligible observations available before the target.
The fixed fourteen-lag autoregressive ridge forecast using actual demand dated before the target only.
The EIA type DF value for the same authority and target date.

specialist_fit_rule.latest_training_target: The latest date strictly before the forecast target for which actual demand and all required lagged features are complete.

prediction_seal.settlement_rule: Actual demand may be joined only after a sealed prediction exists.

comparators.primary_comparator: The single fixed specialist with the lowest mean seasonal-MASE over the complete prospective common-intersection window, selected only for final comparison after the window closes.
comparators.oracle: The per-target lowest-error specialist, used only to measure routing regret and never available to the router.

inference.paired_delta: Best-fixed-specialist seasonal-MASE minus router seasonal-MASE; positive favors the router.
inference.bootstrap: 10000 deterministic balancing-authority cluster-bootstrap draws with seed 20260713.
inference.sign_test: Exact two-sided sign test over nonzero balancing-authority-month mean deltas.
inference.reporting: Report every authority, month, route, fallback, and negative result before any aggregate summary.

claim_boundary: A passing result supports prospective public-data evidence for a frozen hybrid forecast router. It does not establish patent validity or scope, utility field control, realized savings, grid reliability improvement, production readiness, trading edge, or universal model superiority.
